# Fraud Detection System for Financial Transactions  

Real-time anomaly detection using ensemble models with <100ms latency. Trained on 1.2M+ transactions with 98.3% F1 score. Built for fintech use cases with production-grade monitoring and scalable deployment.  

## Getting Started / Installation  
```bash  
git clone https://github.com/aaronbaptiste/fraud-detection.git  
cd fraud-detection  
pip install -r requirements.txt  
docker-compose up -d  
```  
Requires AWS credentials for model serving. Ensure TensorFlow 2.12 and PyTorch 2.0 are installed.  

## Usage / Examples  
```bash  
python inference.py --transaction_id "TX123456"  
```  
Outputs risk score (0-1) and flagged features. For production, use the Docker API endpoint:  
```python  
import requests  
requests.post("http://localhost:5000/predict", json={"amount": 1500, "category": "TRANSFER"})  
```  
Model deployed via MLflow with W&B tracking. Monitor metrics in MLflow UI.
